svg.text: Sample data: shape vs target, a mockup with example measurements of 14 Mar
Front view, schematic. Your shape is filled; the target is the orange outline and tint. Height 162 cm.
The bar shows how much of the target size you have (for waist, abdomen and hips: how close you are from above).
Where the gap is: in this sample, mostly the shoulders, chest and arms (to grow) and the hips (to shrink).
How the target is set: proportions of a wide-shouldered, lean, strong build scaled to your 162 cm
(shoulders 72% of height, waist 44%, chest 60%, hips 52%, biceps and calves 22%, thighs 34%).
There are no official measurements, so this is a model of the look, and every number can be edited.
Some targets (biceps 36 cm, thighs 56 cm) are at the high end for a natural lifter and take years.
Tape method matters: measure biceps the same way every time (flexed or relaxed).
